summary: AstraZeneca PLC filed a Form 6-K on July 9, 2026, under the SEC's Rule 13a-16, reporting an update on the CARDIO-TTRansform Phase III clinical trial for Wainua (eplontersen) in adults with transthyretin-mediated amyloid cardiomyopathy. The trial did not meet its primary composite efficacy endpoint of cardiovascular mortality and recurrent cardiovascular events versus placebo, though safety was consistent with prior results. This is a routine disclosure of clinical trial results, not a special situation involving an M&A event, activist campaign, restructuring, or any other special-situation category. No deal terms apply.
